headline: Open a meeting on Today to prepare it: its agenda, the goal to walk out with and a call guide you can edit, each edit with Undo. An off-limits list that cannot be read is now set aside, and you can restore it. On a Superhuman seat, Today can read your business calendar live once you say yes to one question. The Update keeps each document's version and spends fewer turns, and All open fits a phone's screen. After updating, say "update my hub" once and reload the Hub tab.
